verdict.rationale: Deepgram has a dedicated models-languages-overview docs page. Its docs also state some per-model differences: flux-general-multi covers 10 languages with in-conversation switching, and TTS offers 36 English voices across seven accents. None of the evidence shows the concrete language list itself or a per-feature language matrix. Missing for 10: the actual enumerated list of supported languages, per-model and per-feature language support tables (e.g., for diarization, smart formatting, redaction and audio intelligence), and independent corroboration.
